title: Full faithfulness in canonical tensor-section coordinates
statement: Let X be a scheme and A a functor from its ordinary invertible modules to its etale line modules [def-trf-scheme-etale-line-comparison-data]. Suppose additive-sheaf isomorphisms alpha_L identify A(L) with the canonical tensor-section sheaf, respecting scalar multiplication, and identify A(h) with the global sections of every tensor-pulled module map. Then A is full and faithful, for all module morphisms.

source.place: Tag 03DX (proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent), part (2); Tag 05VG (lemma-equivalence-quasi-coherent-properties), finite local freeness, specialized to rank one; Tag 03LC (proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent-functorial), part (1), for pullback compatibility. The equivalence is restricted to invertible modules.

proof.text: Invertible modules are quasi-coherent. Apply [lem-trf-etale-extension-free-presentations-hom]. Compose alpha with the inverse of its scalar-linear tensor-section comparison to obtain objectwise module-sheaf isomorphisms from A(L) to extension(L). The two morphism formulas imply naturality of these isomorphisms. Conjugation identifies the Hom map of A with the bijective Hom map of extension. Lift preimages through the full subcategory and cancel the conjugating isomorphisms for injectivity.

lean.statement: theorem etale_line_sections_fullFaithful {X : Scheme.{u}} (A : TrfInvertibleModules X ⥤ TrfEtaleLineModules X) (α : ∀ L : TrfInvertibleModules X, trfLineSections (A.obj L) ≅ trfInvertibleSections L) (hscalar : ∀ (L : TrfInvertibleModules X) (U : X.Etale) (r : Γ(U.left, ⊤)) (s : (A.obj L).obj.val.obj (op U)), (α L).hom.hom.app (op U) (r • s) = (((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj L.obj).smul r).hom ((α L).hom.hom.app (op U) s)) (hmap : ∀ (L K : TrfInvertibleModules X) (h : L.obj ⟶ K.obj) (U : X.Etale) (s : (A.obj L).obj.val.obj (op U)), (α K).hom.hom.app (op U) ((trfComparisonMap A h).val.app (op U) s) = ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).map h).app ⊤ ((α L).hom.hom.app (op U) s)) : A.Full ∧ A.Faithful
